info.title: SP Wallet core API
info.description:
Everything a wallet client (web, macOS, iOS) uses outside `/api/v1/trading`: authentication, accounts, portfolio, transfers, activity, address book, settings, security, alerts, events, analytics, search.

Authentication: the owner session — a `__Host-spw` cookie set by the passkey sign-in. Every mutating request also carries `Origin` (the wallet's own origin) and `X-SPW-CSRF: 1`. An API key (`Authorization: Bearer spw_live_…`) opens nothing here.

ADDITIVE: no member is ever removed, renamed or retyped; every object is open — ignore members you do not know. New routes and members only.

AMOUNTS are strings of integer base units, next to a display string computed with exact arithmetic. Fiat figures are decimal strings. Market prices are display numbers and are never used as amounts.

ESTIMATES are flagged: a figure that is an estimate, partial or stale carries the member that says so (`complete`, `estimate`, `stale`, `unvalued`, `unknown`…). An estimate is never called a realised return.

ENUMERATIONS are components. `x-spw-open: true` means new values may appear in a later release: decode with an "unknown" fallback (the known values are in `x-spw-values`). `x-spw-open: false` is frozen for good.

ERRORS are `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<English sentence>", "data"?: … }`. Every operation lists its codes with their status in `x-spw-errors`; `x-spw-errors-open` means a chain adapter or the signer can add one of its own (`signer_<code>`). What each code means and what to do: `x-spw-error-catalog`. A 400 `bad_request` from input validation carries `data.fields` (path, code, message — never the submitted value).

A transfer's state is read in `lifecycle` (`x-spw-lifecycle`). `state` keeps the vocabulary shipped clients know and never grows. Once an approval left the device its outcome is unknown until the server answers: re-read the proposal, never assume failure.

IDLE RULE. A session ends after 30 minutes without activity (12 hours at most). A client marks the requests made on a real interaction of the user with the header `X-SPW-Interaction: 1` (`x-spw-interaction-header`); from the first such request on, only those keep the session alive — background polling no longer does. A session that never sent the header keeps the earlier behaviour (any authenticated request refreshes it).

CONTROL CHARACTERS. A NUL anywhere in a request (query, path, JSON body), or any control character in the query string or a path parameter, is refused with 400 `bad_request` before the route runs.

Other route families of the same server are documented elsewhere: `x-spw-other-families`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Passkey sign-in and the one-time setup. The session is a `__Host-` HttpOnly cookie; nothing here returns a token.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Networks, the verified asset registry, the wallet's addresses, asset preferences, market prices.

tags.name: Portfolio
tags.description: Balances with the provenance of their read, the server-computed summary, value history.

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description: A transfer is prepared (draft), frozen and shown (request-approval), approved with a passkey assertion over the intent hash, then followed on-chain. Read `lifecycle`.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: What the wallet did and received.

tags.name: AddressBook
tags.description: Contacts: labels for the owner's eyes. The destination approved is always the full address shown on the review.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Language, currency, appearance: shared by every device.

tags.name: Security
tags.description: Signer state, passkeys, sessions, the audit chain, the emergency halt.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: In-app alerts, their settings, Web Push subscriptions, the optional webhook.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: The wallet event log: how clients stay in step without re-reading everything on a timer.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Read-only aggregates that compose the wallet and the trading services.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Flows, fees paid, outcomes and counterparties, from recorded facts only.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: One search over assets, contacts and transactions.

post.summary: One-time setup: enrol the first passkey with the signer's setup token
post.description: The signer validates the one-time token and pins the passkey as the only approver. Sets the session cookie. A wrong token is refused by the signer (`signer_<code>`, 422).

503.description: A backing service is unavailable; nothing was done: `signer_unreachable`

post.summary: Sign-in: assertion options

options.description: WebAuthn options (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions / CreationOptions as JSON), to hand to the platform API

post.summary: Sign-in: verify the assertion, open a session
post.description: Sets the `__Host-spw` cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict). A challenge is single-use. A passkey the signer no longer lists opens no session (`login_failed`); when the signer does not answer, or holds no passkey at all, the API's own table decides — the wallet can then be viewed, and nothing can be approved.

post.summary: End this session

post.summary: Add a passkey, step 3: the enrolled passkey's assertion; the signer verifies it and pins the new passkey
post.description: Refusals are the signer's own: `signer_bad_approval`, `signer_expired`, `signer_cooldown` (the approving passkey was added too recently), `signer_self_approval`… A lost answer is safe to repeat: when the signer says the request was already applied and lists the passkey, the call succeeds.

post.description: The challenge is single use. The signer judges the approval (`signer_bad_approval`, `signer_cooldown`, `signer_last_credential`…). A row the signer does not list is removed on the API's own verification of the same request by a passkey the signer does list (`bad_approval` otherwise).

CredentialRequest.description: The canonical credential request. The WebAuthn challenge of `options` is the SHA-256 of its domain-separated, length-prefixed serialisation (domain `SPW-CRED-v2`; fields v, action, requestId, keyId, credentialId, publicKey — empty for a revocation —, createdAt, expiresAt, in that order). A client that shows or re-derives what is being approved reads it here; the signer verifies the approval itself.

DepositDetection.description: How a native-coin deposit was located: its transaction, a contract call inside a block, or a balance difference over a block window (`txidIsBlock`).

DepositKind.description: external = someone paid the wallet; internal = the result of one of the wallet's own operations (`origin` says which).

DepositOrigin.description: The own operation an internal deposit comes from. `agent_withdrawal` and `venue_withdrawal` come back from the owner's own accounts outside the wallet.

code.description: zod issue code: invalid_type, too_small, too_big, invalid_format, invalid_value, unrecognized_keys, invalid_union, custom…

message.description: what is expected — never the value that was sent

EventType.description: Types of the wallet event log. Every audit type matching deposit.*, device.*, session(s).*, addressbook.*, settings.*, halt.*, security.* is mirrored: new types appear without notice.

FlowScope.description: Classification of a movement: external (in from / out to someone else), internal (the wallet's own swaps, bridges, self-transfers: nothing entered or left), ownAccounts (to / from the owner's agent vaults and venue accounts).

Lifecycle.description: The life cycle of a transfer as a client shows it — one vocabulary for web, macOS and iOS. Only `confirmed` means done.

x-spw-value-docs.draft: prepared, nothing frozen; expires by itself
x-spw-value-docs.awaiting_confirmation: the exact transaction is frozen and shown; the passkey has not been given
x-spw-value-docs.awaiting_signature: the passkey was given; the signer call is in flight
x-spw-value-docs.signed: signed; no relay to the network has started
x-spw-value-docs.broadcasting: signed and a relay has started: from here only the chain can say that nothing was sent
x-spw-value-docs.pending: handed to the network, not in a block yet
x-spw-value-docs.confirming: in a block, not final (see `confirmations`); a reorganisation can still undo it
x-spw-value-docs.confirmed: FINAL. The only value a client may treat as done
x-spw-value-docs.failed: ended without effect, or reverted on-chain (`errorCode` says which)
x-spw-value-docs.replaced: another transaction used the same nonce or coins. Still re-checked for a day (`watched`): it becomes confirming / confirmed if it turns out to be in a block
x-spw-value-docs.dropped: no source knows it and nothing proves it dead. NOT a failure: it stays watched and is recorded if it appears; a new send on the network replaces it
x-spw-value-docs.expired: the approval window passed before the passkey, or the validity window of the signed transaction closed on-chain (`errorCode: expired_onchain`); nothing moved
x-spw-value-docs.rejected: rejected by the owner before signing
x-spw-value-docs.not_sent: signed and deliberately not relayed (broadcasting is disabled on this server)

finalized.description: true exactly when the transaction is final

watched.description: true for a dropped or replaced transfer the worker still re-checks

x-spw-value-docs.broadcast_disabled: signed but NOT broadcast: broadcasting is disabled on this server (SPW_BROADCAST=off); nothing was sent to the network
x-spw-value-docs.interrupted_signing: interrupted during signing; nothing was broadcast
x-spw-value-docs.not_broadcast_in_time: could not be broadcast in time; nothing was sent
x-spw-value-docs.relay_unconfirmed: handed to the network without an acknowledgement and not found on-chain; it stays watched and is recorded if it appears. A new transfer on this network replaces it
x-spw-value-docs.dropped: no longer known to the network and not confirmed; it stays watched and is recorded if it appears. A new transfer on this network replaces it
x-spw-value-docs.expired_onchain: its validity window closed before the network included it; nothing moved
x-spw-value-docs.replaced_onchain: another transaction used the same nonce or the same coins; this one can no longer be included
x-spw-value-docs.swap_late: the swap could not be sent in time; nothing was swapped
x-spw-value-docs.swap_approval_reverted: the token approval reverted; nothing was swapped
x-spw-value-docs.swap_would_revert: the swap would revert now ({detail}); it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.swap_would_revert_approved: the swap would revert now ({detail}); it was not sent. The exact-amount approval stays in place for the next attempt
x-spw-value-docs.bridge_late: the transfer could not be sent in time; nothing was burned
x-spw-value-docs.bridge_approval_reverted: the token approval reverted; nothing was burned
x-spw-value-docs.burn_would_revert: the burn would revert now ({detail}); it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.burn_would_revert_approved: the burn would revert now ({detail}); it was not sent. The exact-amount approval stays in place for the next attempt

x-spw-value-docs.xswap_approval_reverted: the token approval reverted; nothing was sent to the vault
x-spw-value-docs.deposit_would_revert: the deposit would revert now ({detail}); it was not sent

x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_unverified: the stored swap no longer verifies; it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_expired: the swap expired before it could be sent (blockhash too old); nothing was swapped
x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_refused: the node refused the signed swap ({detail}); it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_would_fail: the swap would fail now ({detail}); it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_below_min: the swap no longer delivers the approved minimum in simulation; it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_swap_no_balances: the node did not report the simulated balances; the swap was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_burn_mismatch: the signer returned a transaction that is not the approved burn; it was not sent
x-spw-value-docs.sol_burn_expired: the transfer expired before it could be sent (blockhash too old); nothing was burned
x-spw-value-docs.sol_burn_refused: the node refused the signed burn ({detail}); it was not sent

TransferWarning.description: Warning codes of a transfer review. A client shows an unknown code as a generic caution.

x-spw-value-docs.new_destination: the wallet never sent to this address and it is not in the address book — to acknowledge before approving
x-spw-value-docs.address_poisoning_suspected: the address differs from a known one but starts and ends with the same characters: the classic look-alike of an address-poisoning attack — to acknowledge before approving
x-spw-value-docs.duplicate_recent: the same asset, amount and destination was sent, or may have been sent, in the last 24 hours — to acknowledge before approving
x-spw-value-docs.contract_destination: the destination is a contract (EVM) or a program-owned account (Solana), not a plain wallet: it may not be able to use what it receives
x-spw-value-docs.network_congested: the network is congested: the fee is capped, so the transfer may expire without being included (nothing moves in that case)
x-spw-value-docs.creates_account: the destination account does not exist yet on this network: the transfer creates it and part of the amount stays locked as its reserve
x-spw-value-docs.creates_token_account: Solana: the destination has no account for this token; the transfer creates it and the sender pays its rent
x-spw-value-docs.near_creates_account: NEAR: the destination account does not exist yet; the transfer creates it, which adds a fee paid by the sender
x-spw-value-docs.activates_account: the address was never used on this network: activating it is charged to the sender on top of the amount (TRON)
x-spw-value-docs.deploys_wallet: TON: the first outgoing transfer also deploys the wallet contract (slightly higher fee, cannot be simulated beforehand)
x-spw-value-docs.destination_not_initialized: TON: no contract is deployed at the destination (a new wallet, or a wrong address); the funds are credited there and cannot bounce back
x-spw-value-docs.memo_numeric_id: Stellar: the memo is digits only and is sent as a numeric id (MEMO_ID), the format exchanges expect
x-spw-value-docs.dt_new_account: Polkadot Asset Hub: the destination account does not exist yet; this transfer creates it and it must always keep the existential deposit
x-spw-value-docs.cd_token_outputs: Cardano: some outputs of this wallet carry native tokens or script data; they are never spent and their ADA stays locked with them
x-spw-value-docs.l1_fee_unknown: OP-stack networks: the L1 data fee could not be read; the fee ESTIMATE covers the L2 part only and the chain charges the data fee on top (it is not a field the signer can bound)

id.description: increasing; the position a client remembers

ref.description: the object to re-read (a proposal id…)

bad_address.meaning: the destination is not a valid address of this network, or is the wallet itself

bad_amount.meaning: the amount is not a positive decimal within the asset's precision

bad_approval.meaning: the approval could not be verified against the signer's list
bad_approval.action: approve again with a passkey the signer lists

bad_destination.meaning: the destination cannot receive this asset (account type, missing trust line…)

bad_memo.meaning: the memo / destination tag is not accepted on this network

bad_request.meaning: the request is not valid; `data.fields` lists the refused members when it comes from input validation
bad_request.action: fix the request; do not retry unchanged

bad_source.meaning: the wallet's own account cannot send this asset in its present state

bad_state.meaning: the proposal is not in a state that allows this
bad_state.action: re-read the proposal and show its real state

below_rent.meaning: the transfer would leave an account below its rent-exempt minimum

below_reserve.meaning: the transfer would leave the account below the network reserve

challenge_expired.meaning: the challenge expired or was already used
challenge_expired.action: ask for new options and try again

contract_destination.meaning: the destination is a contract that cannot receive this transfer

csrf.meaning: a mutating request without the same-origin proof (`Origin` + `X-SPW-CSRF: 1`)
csrf.action: send both headers; never retry from another origin

duplicate_contact.meaning: another contact already has this address

expired.meaning: the approval window, or the pending passkey, expired

fee_ceiling.meaning: the fee needed exceeds the signer's ceiling

fee_too_high.meaning: the network fee is above the wallet's ceiling right now, or could not be established

halted.action: nothing can be signed until the halt is lifted on the signer

hash_mismatch.meaning: the signer answered another intent hash; the transfer was marked failed

idempotency.meaning: the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or malformed (16–64 letters, digits, dashes)
idempotency.action: send one key per intended transfer

idempotency_mismatch.meaning: this Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request

insufficient_funds.meaning: the balance does not cover the amount and the fee

insufficient_gas.meaning: not enough of the network's native coin to pay the fee

insufficient_unlocked_funds.meaning: part of the balance is locked

internal.action: retry later; a transfer approval is NOT retried blindly — re-read the proposal first

invalid_cursor.meaning: the cursor is not one a previous page returned

last_credential.meaning: the last passkey on the signer cannot be revoked

login_failed.meaning: authentication failed (unknown passkey or bad assertion)
login_failed.action: try again; repeated failures raise an alert

memo_required.meaning: the destination requires a memo / tag

no_approver.meaning: no other passkey can approve this revocation (none enrolled on the signer and out of its cool-down)
no_approver.action: wait for the cool-down of the other passkey, or add one

owner_only.meaning: the route is for the owner's session, not an API key

pending_tx.meaning: another transfer or swap on this network is not confirmed yet
pending_tx.action: wait for it; a dropped one no longer blocks

policy.meaning: the signer's policy refuses it (limit per transfer, per day, asset not allowed, halt)
policy.action: see the message; limits are changed on the signer only

protocol_changed.meaning: the network's protocol changed since this wallet was reviewed; sending is suspended

rate_limited.meaning: too many requests from this address

registration_failed.meaning: the passkey registration could not be verified

rpc_degraded.meaning: not enough data sources answered for this network; nothing was prepared

rpc_disagreement.meaning: the data sources disagree; nothing was prepared

runtime_changed.meaning: the network's runtime changed since this wallet was reviewed; sending is suspended

self_approval.meaning: a passkey cannot approve its own revocation

setup_closed.meaning: the one-time setup was already completed

setup_token.action: ask for the token printed by the signer

signer_unreachable.meaning: the signer cannot be reached; nothing was signed
signer_unreachable.action: reads still work; retry sending later

simulation_failed.meaning: the exact transaction could not be built or would fail now
simulation_failed.action: see the message; nothing was signed

stale_contact.meaning: the contact changed since it was read
stale_contact.action: reload it before changing its address

too_many_coins.meaning: too many small coins are needed for this amount

too_many_streams.meaning: too many event streams are open
too_many_streams.action: close one, or fall back to polling

unauthenticated.action: sign in with the passkey, then repeat the request

unsupported_account.meaning: the account type is not supported

unsupported_asset.meaning: the asset is not in the verified registry of this network

unsupported_funds.meaning: the balance is of a kind this wallet does not spend

unsupported_network.meaning: the signer has no key for this network
